newsitem.title: UK: BT says MOD contract will create jobs.
newsitem.headline: BT says MOD contract will create jobs.

text.p: British Telecommunications Plc said on Wednesday that many new job opportunities will be created by the award of a contract to provide an advanced fixed telecomms network for the UK armed forces.
However the group did not specify how many jobs might result from the deal.

The 700 million stg contract was awarded earlier by the Ministry of Defence to a consortium led by BT and which also includes U.S. company Lockheed Martin, GEC-Marconi, a unit of General Electric Co Plc and GPT Strategic Communications.
"Many new job opportunities will be created by the project and a considerable number of MoD people involved with the existing network will be transfrred," BT said in a statement.
BT said detailed contractual negitiations will now take place to iron out details before the contract is signed.
This is expected in March 1997. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
